reviews.comment: Overall he was nice. He cares soo much about attendance. He very often puts you on the spot with a random question. There are multiple presentations and a group project. The assignments themselves are not too bad but the workload isn't that light either. At least he is charismatic.

I loved Dr. Sadler's class. He clearly cares about his students, and his class was fun and pretty laid-back overall. There were several group projects that were time-consuming and were work, but they were honestly pretty fun. He has a pretty clear grading criteria, gives good feedback, and is overall a great professor. Would definitely recommend.

Sadler is great! He's willing to help and makes his expectations clear. Attendance is mandatory and if you miss more than three classes your grade suffers. There's two essays, a solo poster presentation, and a group project. You also have to participate so do the readings.

This class was just so great! All of the lectures and assignments are very clear and the textbook is free. Professor Sadler is amazing and so caring towards his students! If you make an effort, that's all that matters. Also, this professor is very anti-AI, so I would advise not touching any sort of AI at all. Also, take notes and do the readings.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor is fun and engaging but very passionate about teaching. Cares a lot about participation and effort.

Professor Sadler was great! As long as you do the readings (most of them were actually fun movies like The Hunger Games or KPop Demon Hunters) or at least read a summary, you will be fine in class. You will have to participate in discussion but they are very laid back and easy to get participation points. Overall, easy grader and very funny!

His lectures were so entertaining that I never dreaded going to his classes! There were lots of group projects and readings (mostly watching movies or shows, actually), but I found them enjoyable. He was relaxed on grading as long as you tried, so I'd highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I would only take this professor if you are okay with having to speak up in class. Do not get on your phone and attendance is mandatory. He made class interesting and I did well. Ask for help and participate.

One of the best profs I've had! I took him for both 104 and 210. He keeps class engaging with modern materials and pop culture in different formats, making discussions fun and relevant. Really helped me improve my writing and critical thinking. Gives “pop quizzes” but always lets you know at least a day before. Loved his class!

Sadler is a kind, outgoing professor who makes class engaging with lots of discussion and even movies. Participation is key, so attendance is important. Just be aware—some students felt he graded differently if your views didn't align with his, so keep that in mind during assignments and discussions.

As a person, he really cares about our education & pushed us, but mandatory lectures felt too long. We'd learn basic stuff & read/watch material that was very shallow, filling up time with theories & grammar rules. It was quite a bit of work for an elective & most of the material was extremely biased, but if you participate & show up, you're fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Sadler is nice, but he is incredibly biased and one-dimensional in his teaching, which makes the class less enjoyable. The class is big on participation and projects, which are not complicated but annoying to manage, depending on your group. If you like group-based classes and heavily biased professors, I would recommend it, but if not, then no
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Small class that I took for credit. Honeslty just annoying that attendance was absolutely mandatory when sometimes in class all we would do it hear him talk the whole time. Very basic level english class stuff, hard to stay awake sometimes. He is a very passionate professor and cares students, idk that I would recommend. easy A but lot to endure
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The most flamboyant person I have ever met loves the sound of their voice and will talk the whole class, then get upset when people don't ask questions. I wasn't a fan of his teaching style; it is an easy A class and is a generous grader. You review basic High School writing elements, do easy projects, and only do one essay.

Amazing professor who genuinely cares about students. Takes a few classes getting used to but if you go to class and do your assignments on time you will get an easy A. Also get ready for group projects.

Very flamboyant prof, but once you get past that he's cool. Strict no phone policy, will call you out for it. Overall is pretty easy but if you skip or slack off, it will catchup to you. I got lazy at the end of the semester and skipped a few classes, and forgot a discussion post and got a B cause of it. Not much actual writing for an engl class.
Easy grader, not the most "fun" class, participation matters.

Very particular. Attendance is a large chunk of your grade and has a terrible policy for if you miss. Be aware that if you do not align with his political beliefs (and he is aware of it), your grade will unfortunately will affected. His grading criteria is clear however does not give substantial feed back.

If you don't align with his political views, he will target you and your grade might be affected. He's very attendance heavy and participation heavy. Literally 15% of your grade. Don't get too political, I saw some people getting affected with their grades because of this. As long as you don't do this, he will not be a tough grader.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really, REALLY fruity, but you get used to it after a few weeks and he was still a good professor. Made pretty clear what he was looking for in essays/papers via his rubrics, and the in-class quizzes weren't particularly difficult, assuming you just read the powerpoints.

Dr. Sadler was a decent professor. He used many pop culture references in his lectures, and made an effort to get to know his students and be as helpful as possible. Easy grader but very strict on attendance. Occasionally would make petty and sassy comments, but they were only directed at you if you didn't put in any effort. Don't be on your phone.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It was truly a pleasure to take Dr. Sadler's class. The lectures were really entertaining. Be prepared to write a lot.

Professor Sadler is very kind and makes sure you succeed in his class. Overall is very easy to pass even as someone who's not good at writing. Grade is heavily based on attendance and will make you participate. Strict on due dates but will extend a few hours if needed.
i took engl 210 with him. tbh, screw him, hard grader. who cares about writing. it's all written by AI in the future anyways.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Sadler, he's super nice and funny, and the class was great. I'm a STEM major, and had to take an English class, and it honestly exceeded my expectations. We watched a movie a week and wrote a 500 word analysis over it. We would also take weekly quizzes but none of them were hard at all. I enjoyed the movies we watched too!

Prof. Sadler is amazing! We read books that were actually really interesting and that's coming from someone who doesn't like English. There were a couple papers but Prof. Sadler is not a hard grader if you try and offers good feedback for the next paper. There was also two or three group presentations that were fun to do!
Everyone needs to take Landon's classes!!! He is the nicest guy ever. The class was so much fun. Really easy readings and just a few papers. Easiest literature credit of all time.

I LOVED HIS CLASS!!!!! This has been one of my most enjoyable English classes. I loved him as a professor and person. The material he teaches on is always interesting. We watched black mirror, handmaidens tale, Beyonce music videos, etc. He gives great feedback and made me a better writer. 100% recommend and would take again
Professor Sadler gives good writing feedback. Simply do the work and show up to class and you will get a good grade. He is always there to help or revise essays before you turn them in.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Landon is super cool! He keeps up so well with current events and the class is kind of centered around class discussions about these events.  He cancelled class often. For the assignments, you write 4 papers, which are not hard at all. He grades fair. Dont buy the books, you wont need them.
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The best TA Ive ever had. Made my first semester amazing. Still a good friend of mine. Next year he is teaching another course, and Im super excited about it!

Sadler is great professor who really cares about his students. There were four grades for the course, three papers and an annotated bibliography, with sparse readings in English grammar books used for easy quiz grades. He let everyone chose what their papers would be about, allowing complete creativity. His class is great 10/10 recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
